title: The name '…' is ambiguous because it is defined in the libraries ….
summary: Try using a prefix for one of the import directives, or hiding the name from all but one of the imports.
message_templates: The name '{}' is ambiguous because it is defined in the libraries {}.
The prefix '{}' can't be used to reference a library, because it's used to import more than one library: {}.

title: The name '…' is defined in the libraries '…' and '…'.
summary: Try removing the export of one of the libraries, or explicitly hiding the name in one of the export directives.
message_templates: The name '{}' is defined in the libraries '{}' and '{}'.

title: A member named '…' is defined in '…' and '…', and neither is more specific.
summary: Try using an extension override to specify the extension you want to be chosen.
message_templates: A member named '{}' is defined in '{}' and '{}', and neither is more specific.
A member named '{}' is defined in {}, and none are more specific.

title: The … '…' is defined in the libraries ….
summary: Try using 'as prefix' for one of the import directives, or hiding the name from all but one of the imports.
message_templates: The {} '{}' is defined in the libraries {}.

title: The literal can't be either a map or a set because it contains at least one literal map entry or a spread operator spreading a 'Map', and at least one element which is neither of these.
summary: Try removing or changing some of the elements so that all of the elements are consistent.
message_templates: The literal can't be either a map or a set because it contains at least one literal map entry or a spread operator spreading a 'Map', and at least one element which is neither of these.

title: This literal must be either a map or a set, but the elements don't have enough information for type inference to work.
summary: Try adding type arguments to the literal (one for sets, two for maps).
message_templates: This literal must be either a map or a set, but the elements don't have enough information for type inference to work.
